Only its lexer is used. Tokens are rendered as DOM nodes; HTML is literal text,
unsafe/relative links remain text, and images become explicit links without requests.
No parsed HTML is assigned to innerHTML. Update this module and license together,
then rerun preview security and geometry tests. No runtime CDN request is needed.
